fee_note: You will get a payment receipt by email.
intl_note: Studying outside India? You are very welcome. AlliedPath teaches to the Indian NCAHP curriculum, so it works best as extra support alongside your own course. It is not preparation for licensing or registration exams in your country.
terms:
AlliedPath is a teaching and mentoring service run by ResearchMed Connect.
- AlliedPath does not award certificates, diplomas or degrees and is not a university or registered training institution. Your qualification comes from your own college or university.
- "NCAHP-aligned" means our teaching follows the published NCAHP curriculum. AlliedPath is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions.
- Class links, notes and recordings are for your personal learning only. Please do not share or resell them.
- Be respectful to faculty and fellow students. We may remove anyone who disrupts sessions or harasses others, without a refund.
- Batch dates and times may occasionally change. We will tell you in advance and offer another slot.
- Placement and interview guidance helps you prepare; it does not guarantee a job.
refund:
- Cancel at least 3 days before your batch starts: full refund.
- Cancel after that but before the second class: 50% refund.
- After the second class: no refund, but you may move once to a later batch of the same program.
- If we cancel or postpone a batch and you cannot join the new dates: full refund.
- Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7–10 working days. Email alliedpath@researchmed.in with your reference number to ask for one.
privacy_note: When you register, book a demo, reserve a seat or ask a doubt, we receive the details you type (name, email, WhatsApp number, country, program and message). We use them only to reply to you and to run your classes. We do not sell or share them for marketing. You can ask us to delete your details at any time by emailing alliedpath@researchmed.in.
